articles.summary: The following fixes and features are available on the stable channel: Features & Improvements Added Brand Context , allowing the AI Assistant to follow your brand identity, visual style, and tone. Brand Context can be configured at runtime

Document Builder now offers a more complete page-aware editing experience, bringing the canvas and exported PDF closer together. New page-format controls, visual navigation, page-aware tables, pagination warnings, and improved PDF rendering
articles.title: Introducing the New Document Builder Experience
